description: Publish exactly 20 owner-approved, full, original, directly source-verified reviews only. `source_verified` and `full_text_verified` must both be true per review. `date` may be null when the exact day is unverified (no date is shown). `link_kind` must be `review` for an individual source page or `listing` for the platform's real business review listing (with an honest different link label). Review URLs must point to the correct platform. Pending list intentionally empty and stays hidden.
